prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objective “best” tanning salon — it depends on what you want (spray vs. UV beds), where in Charlotte you are, your budget, and how much you value cleanliness, new equipment, or organic products. I can recommend options if you tell me whether you want UV tanning (beds), a spray tan, or a sunless/self-tanning service — and which part of Charlotte you’re near (Uptown, South Charlotte, Ballantyne, NoDa, etc.).

Until you tell me, here are quick tips to find the best local salon for you:
- Decide spray vs. UV. Spray tans are safer (no UV exposure) and generally look natural when done well. UV beds carry skin‑cancer risk.  
- Check recent Google and Yelp reviews and look at photos from customers (last 6–12 months).  
- Look for certifications: spray technicians trained in Versa, Norvell, Mystic, or similar; UV salons with newer beds (Ergoline, Sonnen) and clear sanitation policies.  
- Visit in person if possible: check how clean it is, whether staff answer questions, and if they offer patch tests for spray tans.  
- Compare pricing and packages (single session vs. memberships), and ask about prep/aftercare instructions.  
- Read cancellation/no‑show and liability policies, and if you’re tanning with UV, talk to your dermatologist first if you have risk factors.

If you tell me spray or UV and your neighborhood, I’ll list several well-reviewed salons in Charlotte and point out the best fit for your needs.
